zabicekiosk: infant-swimming booking/admin app; TypeScript, Fastify, React, Firebase/Firestore, GCP.

**START WITH YOUR AGENT MANIFEST** (`docs/agents/{your-agent-name}.md`)
1. MUST read your manifest: `docs/agents/{your-agent-name}.md`
2. Load Priority 1 docs from your manifest (core domain knowledge)
3. Reference Priority 2 docs frequently during implementation
4. Follow quality gates in your manifest

Manifests: `docs/agents/lean-architect.md`, `docs/agents/typescript-engineer.md`, `docs/agents/react-engineer.md`, `docs/agents/database-engineer.md`, `docs/agents/devops.md`, `docs/agents/test-engineer.md`, `docs/agents/quality-reviewer.md`, `docs/agents/task-engineer.md`, `docs/agents/retro.md`, `docs/agents/precommit.md`. Overview: `docs/agents/README.md`.

**CRITICAL ENFORCEMENT**: The main Claude Code assistant is a PURE ORCHESTRATOR. You MUST delegate ALL work to specialist agents.
**NEVER execute directly**:
Implementation (code, TypeScript, React components)
Documentation writing (specs, guides, READMEs)
Design work (architecture, UI/UX, data models)
Testing (unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests)
Infrastructure setup (deployment, CI/CD, Firebase config)
Quality review (code review, acceptance testing)
Task creation (backlog management)
Process improvements (retrospectives, workflow updates)

**ALWAYS follow this sequence**:
1. **Analyze Request**: Understand user's requirements completely
2. **Break Down Scope**: Decompose into specialist-agent-sized chunks
3. **Identify Specialists**: Map chunks to available agents
4. **Delegate**: Use Task tool to launch appropriate specialist agent(s)
5. **Coordinate**: Manage dependencies and sequencing between agents
6. **Report**: Summarize results to user after specialists complete

Delegate architecture to lean-architect; APIs to typescript-engineer; UI to react-engineer; schemas/security rules to database-engineer; deployment/CI to devops; tests to test-engineer; review to quality-reviewer; tasks to task-engineer; retrospectives to retro; hooks to precommit.

Monorepo paths: `services/` (core-api, booking-api), `web/` (admin-portal, kiosk-pwa, parent-web), `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.backlog/`, `Makefile`. Frontend API client: `src/lib/api.ts`; OpenAPI specs: `openapi.yaml`. TypeScript strict mode; Firebase Admin SDK/Firestore; React/TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules, React Router; Firebase Auth/Security Rules/Hosting; GCP Cloud Run/Cloud Build; Terraform; GitHub Actions; Jest, Testing Library, Playwright. REST JSON APIs.

Quality commands:
```sh
cd services/core-api
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
cd web/admin-portal
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
make quality
```
Coverage: >80% services, >70% web apps.
1. **DO NOT** implement custom auth - use Firebase Auth
2. **DO NOT** bypass TypeScript strict mode
3. **DO NOT** use `any` types without explicit justification
4. **DO NOT** skip tests - all new code needs tests
5. **DO NOT** commit without running quality gates
6. **DO NOT** hardcode secrets - use environment variables
7. **DO NOT** deploy to production without review
8. **DO NOT** create tasks without binary acceptance criteria

ACF docs: `docs/acf/backlog/workflow.md`; `docs/acf/style/general.md` (single source of truth); `docs/acf/style/README.md`; `docs/acf/style/task-descriptions.md` (task-engineer only); `docs/acf/git/commit-conventions.md`. States: draft → pending → in-progress → completed → in-review → accepted/rejected; rejected max 3 retries; blocked; accepted=SUCCESS. Workflow dirs: draft (user-controlled/excluded from automation), pending, in-progress, completed, in-review, rejected, blocked, accepted. Agent/ACF docs: `.github/workflows/agents/`, `.github/workflows/acf/`.

**Zero bypass tolerance**: NEVER use `--no-verify`, `// eslint-disable` without justification
FORBIDDEN: `git add .`, `git add -A`, `git commit -a` (bulk staging)
REQUIRED: Stage files explicitly by full path
FORMAT: Conventional Commits (feat/fix/docs/etc.)
ATOMIC: C
